about.intro: I build reliable backend systems across APIs, AI, and cloud.
paragraphs: I’m a Software Engineer at Macquarie Group, working on backend and cloud-native systems within Group Technology and Security. My current work involves building backend services, APIs, workflows, and developer-facing capabilities around Kubernetes-based container platforms.

My broader experience spans backend engineering, cloud infrastructure, and AI-enabled software. Before joining Macquarie, I worked on AI and data systems involving retrieval-augmented generation, data synchronisation pipelines, authentication workflows, and application infrastructure. Across these experiences, I’ve enjoyed turning complex technical capabilities into reliable systems that are easier for people to use.

I hold a Master of Information Technology with Distinction from the University of Melbourne and a Bachelor of Business from QUT. I also completed a short-term exchange in Project Management at Harvard University. My background across technology, business, and project delivery has shaped how I think about engineering—not only in terms of implementation, but also reliability, usability, and the broader problem a system is intended to solve.
I’m particularly interested in backend architecture, distributed systems, cloud platforms, and AI systems, and I enjoy exploring how these areas come together in production software.
